title: Thi Sakina ki yeh sadaa bhaayi
body:
Thi Sakina ki yeh sadaa bhaayi
Dum nikaltaa hai ab mera bhaayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Mera jeena bhi koyi jeena hai
Sar pey baba hai na chacha bhaayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Mein toh jaati hoon paas baba kay
Sab ka Haafiz hai ab Khuda bhaayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Meri maiyyath pey ek choti si
Dal dijiyeh koyi ridaa bhaayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Meray marthay hi qaid sey saaraa
Kunbaa hojaayegaa rihaa bhaayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Maa ko nazdeek sey hattaa dijiyeh
Maa sey dekha na jaayegaa bhaayi
